task3_cors_verification.method: Created minimal HTML with fetch(), opened via chrome-devtools MCP at file:/// URL
task3_cors_verification.explanation: CORS = Cross-Origin Resource Sharing. A browser security policy that blocks web pages from fetching resources from a different 'origin' (protocol + domain + port). When you open an HTML file via file:///path/to/dashboard.html, the origin is 'null'. JavaScript fetch('running-estimate.json') from a file:/// origin is blocked by ALL modern browsers because null origins are not allowed to make fetch requests. This means: a local HTML file CANNOT dynamically load a separate JSON file via JavaScript fetch(). The workaround: embed the JSON data directly into the HTML (which is what the generator script approach does).
task3_cors_verification.architecturalImplication: The feasibility study's recommendation (embedded JSON + generator script) is the ONLY viable approach for local HTML dashboards. No fetch, no polling, no server needed.
